guides.title: 工程檔案：關鍵數據、年代、規範與案例
guides.titleEn: Engineering dossier: key figures, timeline, codes and landmarks
guides.concept: 雙護盾伸縮機構、兩種反力路徑與施工循環的可靠度。本頁區分公開工程資料與明示的教學假設；數值只用於學習比較，不是設計值。
guides.conceptEn: Double-shield telescoping, dual reaction paths and construction-cycle reliability. This dossier distinguishes public project facts from explicitly labelled teaching assumptions; figures are for learning comparisons, not design values.
facts: 教學假設，非現場設定或設計允收值。假設名義行程1.8 m、保留餘量0.3 m，可用行程1.8-0.3=1.5 m；以1.2 m一環計算，只能完整涵蓋floor(1.5/1.2)=1環。
教學假設，非現場設定或設計允收值。假設法向合力8 MN、有效面積4 m²，平均壓力8/4=2 MPa；若有效接觸只剩2 m²，平均壓力變成4 MPa，均非容許值。
教學假設，非現場設定或設計允收值。假設N=8 MN、摩擦係數μ=0.4，軸向摩擦估計μN=3.2 MN；若假設軸向需求2.8 MN，比值3.2/2.8=1.14，非設計安全係數。
教學假設，非現場設定或設計允收值。假設總推力12 MN由24個推靴平均承擔，各為0.5 MN；每個有效面積0.1 m²，名義承壓0.5/0.1=5 MPa，未檢查管片彎裂。
教學假設，非現場設定或設計允收值。假設切削30 min、組環25 min、定位5 min，每環並行循環max(30,25)+5=35 min；順序循環為60 min，理想時間節省25/60=41.7%。
教學假設，非現場設定或設計允收值。假設D=6 m、接觸L=4 m、p=0.2 MPa、μ=0.3，F=μpπDL=4.52 MN；L變為6 m時F=6.79 MN，均為理想均壓摩擦。
factsEn: Teaching assumptions, not operating settings or design acceptance limits. Assume nominal travel 1.8 m and reserved travel 0.3 m. Usable travel is 1.8-0.3=1.5 m, covering floor(1.5/1.2)=1 complete ring of width 1.2 m.

Teaching assumptions, not operating settings or design acceptance limits. Assume normal force 8 MN over effective area 4 m²: mean pressure is 8/4=2 MPa. Reducing effective contact to 2 m² raises it to 4 MPa. Neither is an allowable value.

Teaching assumptions, not operating settings or design acceptance limits. Assume N=8 MN and friction coefficient μ=0.4. Estimated axial friction is μN=3.2 MN. Against an assumed demand of 2.8 MN, the ratio is 3.2/2.8=1.14, not a design safety factor.

Teaching assumptions, not operating settings or design acceptance limits. Assume 12 MN shared equally by 24 shoes: each carries 0.5 MN. With effective area 0.1 m² per shoe, nominal bearing is 0.5/0.1=5 MPa. Segment bending and cracking are not checked.

Teaching assumptions, not operating settings or design acceptance limits. Assume cutting 30 min, assembly 25 min and regripping 5 min. A parallel cycle is max(30,25)+5=35 min versus 60 min sequentially; ideal time saving is 25/60=41.7%.

Teaching assumptions, not operating settings or design acceptance limits. Assume D=6 m, contact length L=4 m, p=0.2 MPa and μ=0.3. Uniform-contact friction is F=μpπDL=4.52 MN; at L=6 m it becomes 6.79 MN.

procedure: 把關鍵數據與本課算例逐項對照，標出哪些是公開工程數據、哪些是教學假設。
沿著工程時間軸，標出設計、施工、事件與維護改造的關鍵決策點，說明每個決策改變了哪一條系統路徑或檢核。
對照列出的規範與標準，找出本課試驗或允收步驟對應的條款類型，並註明版本與適用地區。
從代表工程中選一個與本課比較，列出埋深或斷面、地質水文、支護系統與施工方法的差異。
procedureEn: Compare the key figures with this course's worked example and mark which are public project data and which are teaching assumptions.
Along the timeline, mark the key design, construction, event and retrofit decisions and say which system path or check each one changed.
Against the listed codes and standards, find the kind of clause behind this course's tests or acceptance steps, noting edition and jurisdiction.
Pick one landmark project to compare with this course and list differences in depth or section, ground and groundwater, support system and construction method.

Applying another country's clauses without checking edition, jurisdiction and load combinations.

guides.scope: 依公開工程原理、官方資料與規範架構編寫的原創教學；步驟是可驗證的學習任務與假想算例，不是設計圖說、施工計畫、開挖、注漿或受限空間作業許可，也不是任何專案的設計文件。數值均為教學假設或公開資料，實際工程須由合格技師依規範與實測資料重新計算並簽證。
guides.scopeEn: Original teaching built from public engineering principles, official sources and code frameworks. Steps are verifiable learning tasks and hypothetical exercises, not design drawings, method statements, excavation, grouting or confined-space permits, or any project's design documents. Numbers are teaching assumptions or public data; real work must be recalculated and certified by qualified engineers using codes and measured data.

guides.title: 機制、算例與驗證：雙護盾硬岩潛盾施工
guides.titleEn: Mechanisms, calculations and verification: Double-shield hard-rock TBM operation
guides.concept: 雙護盾可讓切削與管片組裝在不同機構上進行，但並行能力依賴岩壁提供可靠反力、伸縮行程和後勤同步。本課由接觸承壓、軸向推力、循環時間進到擠壓岩與偏轉判讀，將設備能力、地層限制及觀測證據分開列帳。所有數字為教學假設，結論是辨識需要停點審查的條件，不是掘進機操作參數。
guides.conceptEn: A double shield can separate excavation from segment assembly, but concurrent work depends on a reliable rock reaction, available telescopic travel and synchronized logistics. This course follows contact stress, axial thrust and cycle time into squeezing-ground and steering interpretations. Machine capability, ground limitations and observed evidence are recorded separately. All numerical inputs are teaching assumptions; the outcome identifies conditions requiring engineering review rather than machine operating parameters.
procedure: 前盾前移而後盾暫時定位，伸縮接頭讓切削行程與後方作業分離；可用行程仍受幾何餘量與端點限制，不能把名義最大伸長全部用作生產距離。 假設名義行程1.8 m、保留餘量0.3 m，可用行程1.8-0.3=1.5 m；以1.2 m一環計算，只能完整涵蓋floor(1.5/1.2)=1環。 行程訊號漂移會讓顯示餘量大於真實間隙，端點接近時推力突升且循環停頓；若只將停頓歸為岩性變硬，接頭與反力路徑的異常便可能漏判。

撐靴把推進反力傳入有限的岩壁接觸區，平均接觸壓力與局部節理幾何共同影響反力可靠度。總力相同時，真實接觸面積變小會放大局部壓力，完整試體強度不能直接代表破碎岩壁。 假設法向合力8 MN、有效面積4 m²，平均壓力8/4=2 MPa；若有效接觸只剩2 m²，平均壓力變成4 MPa，均非容許值。 沿節理剝落會縮小接觸區，顯示壓力可能仍正常但機體持續滑移；若把提高法向力當成通用解答，岩壁破壞可能擴大並干擾推進控制。

簡化摩擦模型以法向合力乘假設摩擦係數估算軸向抗滑能力；它只描述一個力學分量，未包含節理剪破、撐靴嵌入或機體扭矩。應先把需求與能力放在同一方向再比較。 假設N=8 MN、摩擦係數μ=0.4，軸向摩擦估計μN=3.2 MN；若假設軸向需求2.8 MN，比值3.2/2.8=1.14，非設計安全係數。 水膜或碎屑改變接觸條件，摩擦能力下降但推進需求未下降；反覆滑移會讓位移與行程計不一致，若只看平均推力就可能忽略失去穩定反力。

當岩壁反力不足而改由已完成管片承受推力時，力流轉向推靴接觸、管片接縫及環間傳遞。平均分配僅供列帳，實際偏心和缺口會造成個別推靴較大的局部承壓。 假設總推力12 MN由24個推靴平均承擔，各為0.5 MN；每個有效面積0.1 m²，名義承壓0.5/0.1=5 MPa，未檢查管片彎裂。 接縫不平或墊片缺損會使少數管片先受力，局部崩角與裂縫可能在總推力正常時出現；錯把環平均承壓當局部容許值會漏掉脆弱細部。

能同時進行的切削與組環，循環時間受較慢工序控制，而非兩者相加；重新定位等不可重疊工作仍必須另計。後勤供應若不能配合，並行機構本身不會創造有效進尺。 假設切削30 min、組環25 min、定位5 min，每環並行循環max(30,25)+5=35 min；順序循環為60 min，理想時間節省25/60=41.7%。 若把定位時間藏在兩個工序內又相加，會高估等待；反之忽略等料會高估產能。兩種錯帳都使瓶頸判讀偏離實際，設備改善可能被投入錯誤環節。

擠壓岩體可能在盾殼周圍建立長距離接觸，摩擦阻力取決於壓力、接觸長度和摩擦係數。圓周均壓假設可示範尺度效應，但實際接觸斑塊及時間演化需要另行分析。 假設D=6 m、接觸L=4 m、p=0.2 MPa、μ=0.3，F=μpπDL=4.52 MN；L變為6 m時F=6.79 MN，均為理想均壓摩擦。 停機期間收斂持續發展，重新啟動需求可能提高而行程減少；把所有阻力增加視為刀具磨耗，會忽略盾殼接觸及夾盾風險的時間效應。
左右推進不均可形成轉動和偏心反力，但小角度幾何只能描述位移差，不證明周圍岩體允許該姿態。導向評估還要連接盾殼淨空、線形曲率以及後方環體位置。 假設左右量測基距B=5 m、行程差Δ=10 mm=0.010 m，小角θ≈Δ/B=0.002 rad=0.115°；並非允許導向角。 單側行程感測漂移可能被誤判為機體偏航，導致不必要的受力調整；相反，真實偏心若被當作校正問題，管片與盾殼局部接觸會持續累積。

機械能與開挖體積的比值可用於比較同一設備在不同環段的表現，但它同時受刀具、岩性、轉速與停機分類影響。比能升高不是岩石強度增加的唯一證據，輸入功率也不等於純破岩功率。 假設平均機械功率800 kW、有效切削0.5 h、開挖40 m³，E/V=800×0.5/40=10 kWh/m³=36 MJ/m³，未扣除各項損失。 把整班用電除以少量進尺會製造虛高比能，掩蓋真正的後勤停頓；若據此推定岩體更硬，磨耗或待機問題便可能被錯誤歸因。

日進尺等於有效切削速度乘切削時間，不應在已扣停機的時間上再次乘利用率。分開排程時數與有效切削時數，才能比較維修和供料改善的實際作用，也避免重複扣除同一損失。 假設貫入5 mm/rev、2 rev/min、排程20 h/day、利用率0.5，進尺=5×2×60×20×0.5/1000=6 m/day；利用率0.4時為4.8 m/day。 把有效切削十小時再乘一半利用率會低估進尺，反之將轉動但無進尺列為切削會高估效率；這些定義錯誤會誤導維修投資及工期溝通。

機械、地質與襯砌資料必須透過環號和共同時間串接，才能分辨同一事件前後的因果順序。資料完整率只衡量可追溯程度，不能取代內容正確性；缺測區間更不能默認機器狀態正常。 假設交接要求120個關鍵事件記錄，已驗證114個，完整率114/120=95%；仍有6個未閉合事件，不能以平均完整率取代逐項追查。 環號錯接會把前一環地質套用到後一環載重，產生看似合理但時間錯位的解釋；交接後若只保留彙總圖，原始異常便難以重新核查。
procedureEn: The front shield moves while the rear shield remains temporarily located. Telescoping separates cutting travel from work behind it, but usable travel still depends on geometric reserve and end limits. Nominal maximum extension is not entirely available for production. Assume nominal travel 1.8 m and reserved travel 0.3 m. Usable travel is 1.8-0.3=1.5 m, covering floor(1.5/1.2)=1 complete ring of width 1.2 m. A drifting travel signal can overstate remaining clearance. Near an end limit, thrust may rise while advance stops. Attributing this solely to stronger rock can conceal a telescopic joint or reaction-path problem.

Grippers transmit reaction through a finite rock-wall contact. Average pressure and local discontinuity geometry jointly affect reliability. At fixed force, a smaller effective contact increases local pressure; intact specimen strength does not directly characterize a fractured wall. Assume normal force 8 MN over effective area 4 m²: mean pressure is 8/4=2 MPa. Reducing effective contact to 2 m² raises it to 4 MPa. Neither is an allowable value. Spalling along joints reduces the effective contact. Displayed pressure may look normal while the machine slips. Increasing normal force as a universal remedy may enlarge wall damage and further disturb thrust control.

A simplified friction model multiplies normal force by an assumed coefficient to estimate axial resistance. It represents only one component, excluding joint shear, shoe indentation and machine torque. Demand and resistance must first be resolved in the same direction. Assume N=8 MN and friction coefficient μ=0.4. Estimated axial friction is μN=3.2 MN. Against an assumed demand of 2.8 MN, the ratio is 3.2/2.8=1.14, not a design safety factor. Water films or debris can change contact while thrust demand remains unchanged. Repeated slip produces disagreement between actual motion and ram travel. Mean thrust alone can therefore miss the loss of a dependable reaction.

When reaction shifts from rock walls to completed segments, the load path moves through thrust shoes, segment joints and ring interfaces. Equal allocation is only an accounting model; eccentricity and gaps can create much higher local bearing under individual shoes. Assume 12 MN shared equally by 24 shoes: each carries 0.5 MN. With effective area 0.1 m² per shoe, nominal bearing is 0.5/0.1=5 MPa. Segment bending and cracking are not checked. Uneven joints or damaged packing can engage only a few segments initially. Corner spalling or cracks may appear at a normal total thrust. Treating ring-average bearing as a local allowable stress misses vulnerable details.

For truly overlapping cutting and ring assembly, the slower activity governs elapsed time rather than their sum. Non-overlapping tasks such as regripping remain additional. Concurrent mechanics cannot produce useful advance when supply logistics fail to match the required rhythm. Assume cutting 30 min, assembly 25 min and regripping 5 min. A parallel cycle is max(30,25)+5=35 min versus 60 min sequentially; ideal time saving is 25/60=41.7%. Hiding regripping inside two activities and then adding both overstates delay, while omitting supply waits overstates output. Either bookkeeping error misidentifies the bottleneck and can direct improvements toward the wrong subsystem.

Squeezing ground can establish contact over a long shield length. Resistance depends on pressure, contact length and friction. Uniform circumferential pressure demonstrates scaling, but real contact patches and their evolution with time require separate analysis. Assume D=6 m, contact length L=4 m, p=0.2 MPa and μ=0.3. Uniform-contact friction is F=μpπDL=4.52 MN; at L=6 m it becomes 6.79 MN. Convergence may continue during downtime, increasing restart demand while travel decreases. Attributing all additional resistance to cutter wear can miss time-dependent shield contact and the associated risk of the shield becoming trapped.

Unequal advance can cause rotation and eccentric reaction. Small-angle geometry describes differential movement but does not show that the ground permits the attitude. Steering interpretation must also consider shield clearance, alignment curvature and the positions of completed rings. Assume lateral baseline B=5 m and differential travel Δ=10 mm=0.010 m. The small angle is θ≈Δ/B=0.002 rad=0.115°, not an allowable steering angle. A drifting travel sensor may be mistaken for yaw and prompt unnecessary load changes. Conversely, treating genuine eccentricity as calibration error allows concentrated contact on the shield and segments to persist.

Mechanical energy per excavated volume can compare sections on one machine, but cutters, geology, speed and downtime classification all influence it. Higher specific energy is not unique evidence of stronger rock, and input power is not identical to power used in fragmentation. Assume mean mechanical power 800 kW, cutting duration 0.5 h and excavation 40 m³. E/V=800×0.5/40=10 kWh/m³=36 MJ/m³, before separating individual losses. Dividing whole-shift electricity by limited advance creates an artificially high energy index and hides logistics delays. Inferring harder ground from that number can misclassify wear or standby losses as a geological change.

Daily advance equals active cutting rate multiplied by actual cutting time. Utilization must not be applied again to hours already excluding downtime. Separating scheduled hours from active hours allows meaningful maintenance and supply comparisons without counting the same loss twice. Assume penetration 5 mm/rev, 2 rev/min, schedule 20 h/day and utilization 0.5. Advance is 5×2×60×20×0.5/1000=6 m/day; utilization 0.4 gives 4.8 m/day. Multiplying ten already-active hours by one-half utilization understates advance. Counting rotation without progress as useful cutting overstates efficiency. These definition errors can misdirect maintenance investment and communication about schedule expectations.

Machine, geological and lining records need ring IDs and a common clock to reconstruct event order. Completeness measures traceability rather than correctness. Missing intervals cannot be presumed normal, particularly when they coincide with mode changes or unusual loading. Assume handover requires 120 critical event records and 114 are verified. Completeness is 114/120=95%, leaving six unresolved events; the average percentage cannot replace investigation of each missing item. A misassigned ring ID links one ring's geology to another ring's loading, creating a plausible but temporally false explanation. Retaining only summary plots after handover makes later reconstruction of the anomaly difficult.
evidence: 每一班以共同環號保存行程零點、餘量和定位事件；機械工程師確認傳感器與端點保護，施工主管確認循環可行後才接受新的時間預算。
接觸面積只採有證據的估計值，記錄被遮蔽區域的不確定性；地質工程師審查節理與剝落後，由設備負責人依核准程序判斷反力路徑是否可用。
把μ的來源和替代範圍列為模型輸入，不允許用觀察到的最大值當永久保證；任何操作模式變更均須設備與地工主管共同審核。
模式切換交接表需列出新的受力構件、有效接觸與核准檢查；管片工程師確認受力條件，設備主管再依正式程序決定可否切換。
保留原始事件和重疊判定規則，另做組環時間增加的情境分析；改善方案由施工與後勤主管共同核對，不能只報告刀盤切削速度。
evidenceEn: Keep travel zero, reserve and positioning events under the same ring identifier each shift. The mechanical engineer verifies instrumentation and end protection; the construction lead confirms cycle feasibility before accepting a revised time budget.

Use evidence-based contact-area estimates and record uncertainty in hidden zones. After the geologist reviews joints and spalling, the equipment lead assesses the reaction path using the approved procedure rather than the classroom pressure estimate.

Record the source and alternative range of μ as model inputs. An observed maximum is not a permanent guarantee. Equipment and geotechnical leads must jointly review any proposed operating-mode change.

A mode-change handover lists the newly loaded components, effective contacts and approved checks. The segment engineer confirms the structural conditions before the equipment lead determines whether a change is permissible under the formal procedure.

Preserve raw events and overlap rules, and analyze a longer assembly-duration scenario. Construction and logistics leads jointly review improvements; cutterhead cutting speed alone is not an adequate production report.
pitfalls: 行程訊號漂移會讓顯示餘量大於真實間隙，端點接近時推力突升且循環停頓；若只將停頓歸為岩性變硬，接頭與反力路徑的異常便可能漏判。
水膜或碎屑改變接觸條件，摩擦能力下降但推進需求未下降；反覆滑移會讓位移與行程計不一致，若只看平均推力就可能忽略失去穩定反力。
若把定位時間藏在兩個工序內又相加，會高估等待；反之忽略等料會高估產能。兩種錯帳都使瓶頸判讀偏離實際，設備改善可能被投入錯誤環節。
單側行程感測漂移可能被誤判為機體偏航，導致不必要的受力調整；相反，真實偏心若被當作校正問題，管片與盾殼局部接觸會持續累積。
把有效切削十小時再乘一半利用率會低估進尺，反之將轉動但無進尺列為切削會高估效率；這些定義錯誤會誤導維修投資及工期溝通。
pitfallsEn: A drifting travel signal can overstate remaining clearance. Near an end limit, thrust may rise while advance stops. Attributing this solely to stronger rock can conceal a telescopic joint or reaction-path problem.

Water films or debris can change contact while thrust demand remains unchanged. Repeated slip produces disagreement between actual motion and ram travel. Mean thrust alone can therefore miss the loss of a dependable reaction.

Hiding regripping inside two activities and then adding both overstates delay, while omitting supply waits overstates output. Either bookkeeping error misidentifies the bottleneck and can direct improvements toward the wrong subsystem.

A drifting travel sensor may be mistaken for yaw and prompt unnecessary load changes. Conversely, treating genuine eccentricity as calibration error allows concentrated contact on the shield and segments to persist.

Multiplying ten already-active hours by one-half utilization understates advance. Counting rotation without progress as useful cutting overstates efficiency. These definition errors can misdirect maintenance investment and communication about schedule expectations.

related.title: 潛盾掘進導向控制
related.transfer: 可遷移「伸縮行程與循環約束」與「姿態差與推力偏心」的傳力分析、量測與驗證方法；潛盾掘進導向控制的跨度、荷載、材料與允收條件需重新設定。
related.transferEn: The load-path analysis, measurement and verification methods of "Telescopic travel and cycle constraint" and "Attitude difference and thrust eccentricity" transfer, while ground conditions, loads, materials and acceptance conditions of TBM alignment guidance and control must be respecified.
related.difference: 本課聚焦雙護盾伸縮機構、兩種反力路徑與施工循環的可靠度；潛盾掘進導向控制則以把坐標基準、機身姿態與環片幾何連成可獨立查核的導航鏈為重點，不能直接沿用參數或允收值。
related.differenceEn: This course focuses on double-shield telescoping, dual reaction paths and construction-cycle reliability; TBM alignment guidance and control centres on link coordinate datum, machine attitude and ring geometry in an independently checkable navigation chain, so parameters and acceptance values do not transfer unchanged.
practice: 比較系統邊界：列出「伸縮行程與循環約束」與「控制網與坐標基準」的荷載來源、傳力路徑與主要環境作用。
把本課算例的一個假設移到潛盾掘進導向控制，標出可沿用的方程與必須重設的參數。
以「尾隙與機器環片相對位移」為例，設計一項能區分兩種結構行為的試驗或量測，並註明不確定度與允收準則。
practiceEn: Compare system boundaries: list the load sources, load paths and main environmental actions of “Telescopic travel and cycle constraint” and “Control networks and coordinate datum”.
Move one assumption of this course's worked example to TBM alignment guidance and control, separating reusable equations from parameters that must be respecified.
Using "Relative machine-ring clearance", design a test or measurement that distinguishes the two structural behaviours and state its uncertainty and acceptance criterion.

history.year: 公開工程脈絡 / Public engineering context
history.title: 雙護盾硬岩潛盾施工
history.text: 國際隧協以反力作用於岩壁或已組襯砌來區分雙護盾的工作路徑，海瑞克公開產品摘要則說明前後盾與伸縮構造。二〇〇九年美國公路隧道手冊提供土建背景，二〇一四年Stepney Green論文可作不同支護序列的對照，二〇一六年營運的聖哥達基線隧道提供深埋岩體環境背景。此處未聲稱這些案例均採雙護盾，學習重點是反力路徑如何改變檢查責任。
history.textEn: ITA distinguishes double-shield reaction through rock walls or installed lining, while the public Herrenknecht summary identifies the shield and telescopic arrangement. The 2009 FHWA manual provides civil-engineering context. The 2014 Stepney Green paper supplies a contrasting support sequence, and Gotthard entering operation in 2016 provides a deep-rock setting. These examples are not all presented as double-shield projects. The historical comparison asks how a changed reaction path changes the evidence and responsibility needed for approval.
